name: startup-folder-item-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): plants an All-Users startup-folder item -- a .bat in the common StartUp folder that launches a hidden PowerShell payload at every sign-in. The hardened state is the .bat (and the payload) removed. Vars: ITEM_NAME (required, the .bat base name); PAYLOAD_PATH (required); PAYLOAD_BODY (optional). Pairs with a permission check on the .bat path expecting exists=false. Idempotent (files overwritten).
script:
if (-not $ITEM_NAME -or -not $PAYLOAD_PATH) { throw 'ITEM_NAME and PAYLOAD_PATH are required' }
$dir = Split-Path $PAYLOAD_PATH -Parent
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null
if ($PAYLOAD_BODY) { Set-Content -Path $PAYLOAD_PATH -Value $PAYLOAD_BODY -Encoding ascii }
$startup = Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\StartUp'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $startup | Out-Null
$bat = Join-Path $startup ($ITEM_NAME + '.bat')
Set-Content -Path $bat -Value "@echo off`r`npowershell.exe -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$PAYLOAD_PATH`"" -Encoding ascii
Write-Output "startup item planted: $bat"
